headline: Indian stock benchmarks close higher as Sensex surpasses 81,000 and Nifty reclaims 25,000 level

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Buying in banking stocks lifted market sentiment and supported benchmark indices.
Easing crude oil prices contributed to market recovery from lower levels.
Bulls maintained a firm grip as benchmarks staged a strong recovery from early trade lows.
Bargain hunting and buying interest resurfaced after early profit-taking.
whatHappening: Sensex ended over 100 points higher, settling above the 81,000 level after early dips.
Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 mark following a strong recovery from day's lows.
Early trade witnessed profit-taking and selling pressure in IT stocks.
Stock markets will be closed tomorrow, November 10, for Diwali Balipratipada.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed in the green after recovering from early trade losses caused by profit-taking and IT selling. Sensex crossed 81,000 while Nifty settled above 25,000, aided by buying in bank stocks and lower crude oil prices. Stock markets will remain closed tomorrow for Diwali Balipratipada.
